_about: Directory-level provenance declaration for every shipped asset under
present, OVERRIDES the rule that matches here.
ROM_DERIVED    a named generator reads the ROM (or a ROM-derived
intermediate) and the rule names the ROM address(es) it
reads, which resolve to ROM_MAP.md rows.
GENERATOR_ONLY a named generator exists but the rule cannot name a ROM
address / ROM_MAP row for the values it emits.  Honest
intermediate tier -- NOT the same as verified.
CAPTURE        derived from an emulator save-state, VRAM dump, screenshot
or hand-measured crop.  Must be re-derived.
OWNED_ELSEWHERE another agent/session owns this file in the current pass.
rules are matched longest-pattern-first; 'pattern' is a POSIX glob relative
